## Pull Request Template

### Problem
Describe the specific problem this PR solves. What was the user experience? What failed? What was missing?

### Solution
Describe your change. What does it do differently?

### Skill Changes (if applicable)
If this PR modifies skills:
- [ ] I tested this skill across multiple sessions
- [ ] I verified the skill triggers correctly when its context matches
- [ ] I validated hard gates and red flags still function as intended
- [ ] I followed the SKILL.md format (frontmatter, overview, when to use, process, checklists, hard gates, red flags)

### Framework References
List any PM frameworks, books, or thinkers referenced:
- [Insert references]

### Existing PRs
Search the repository for open AND closed PRs that address the same problem. List what you found and explain how this PR is different.

### Human Review
- [ ] A human has reviewed the complete diff before submission

### Environment Tested
| Harness | Version | Result |
|---------|---------|--------|
| [e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode] | [version] | [Passed/Failed/Not tested] |
